title: People in Helsinki photography
slide_intent: Show varied everyday lives because viewers need opportunities to recognize themselves within a city story.
strategic_value: The event, mobility, older residents, solar-panel setting and snowy street can broaden Helsinki’s visible account of its people.
demonstration: This webpage image strip places five photographs side by side: an event portrait, people including a wheelchair user, older women, a man near solar panels and an adult with a stroller in snow.
practical_value: Compare subject, setting and season across a planned photography selection.

content_islands.spec: Keep the five photographs in one horizontal comparison with their credits below.
